metadata.title: Meta Muse May Be Biggest AI Launch Since ChatGPT. It’s Just One of Many Catalysts for Meta Stock.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Meta Muse May Be Biggest AI Launch Since ChatGPT. It’s Just One of Many Catalysts for Meta Stock.
Meta Platforms has seen continued customer momentum for its new consumer artificial-intelligence agent. Wall Street believes this could be just the beginning and that there is more upside for the shares of the Facebook parent over the next three months.
